manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
